paper_title: MICROSCOPE mission: first constraints on the violation of the weak equivalence principle by a light scalar dilaton
notes: MICROSCOPE WEP test constrains Yukawa fifth-force coupling alpha for scalar coupled to baryon number B (|alpha|<1e-11) and B-L (|alpha|<1e-12) for masses < 1e-12 eV. Paper primarily reports results as exclusion regions in (alpha, lambda) plane (Figs 1,2) and dilaton coupling (De, Dmtilde). Only text-quoted summary values available; full curves are in figures not extractable numerically. Could be classified as ScalarBaryon (B coupling) or VectorBL (B-L coupling) - this is a fifth-force/WEP test. de constraint (~1e-4) for EM-coupled dilaton relates to ScalarPhoton.
